target_pdb.description: Absolute path to the target structure (PDB or mmCIF) the binder is designed against. (Shares the pxdesign schema; this multi-GPU alias forces `mode=pipeline`.)

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `target_pdb` when omitted.

target_chain.description: Chain id of the target on `target_pdb`.

num_samples.description: Total samples across ranks. Must be divisible by the world size of GPUs available.

seed.description: Optional integer RNG seed (forwarded to each rank with a rank-offset).

hotspots.description: 1-indexed target residue positions where the binder should engage.

crop.description: Optional target-region crop selector. Null uses the full target chain.

mode.description: Required pipeline mode for the multi-GPU descriptor alias. Only `pipeline` is valid here.

top_k_designs.description: Number of top filtered designs to return from the pipeline.

mpnn_temperature.description: ProteinMPNN sampling temperature for the sequence-design stage.

af2_init_guess.description: Enable AF2 initial-guess co-folding for sequence filtering.

preset.description: PXDesign upstream preset. `preview` is AF2-only (lighter, faster); `extended` adds Protenix ranking.
